name: Shreya Acquisition Group
summary: Shreya Acquisition Group (SAGU) is primarily focused on executing various strategic business combinations. The firm aims to acquire, merge with, or otherwise integrate with one or more enterprises through transactions such as asset or share purchases, recapitalizations, reorganizations, or similar corporate restructuring initiatives. SAGU specifically targets entities within the health and wellness, hospitality, media and entertainment, shipping infrastructure, and waterways tourism industries. Established in 2025, the company's base of operations is in Port Louis, Mauritius.
